quote: prefix probing (PP) -generate continuations from passage prefixes.
Prefix probing task evaluates whether a model, when given the first half (prefix) of a passage, can reproduce the second half (continuation).

We propose three probing experiments on OWL to assess memorization as well as cross-lingual knowledge transfer: (1) direct probing (DP, §3.1), where the model identifies the title and author of a book passage; (2) name cloze (NC, §3.2), where the model fills in a masked character name; and (3) prefix probing (PP, §3.3), where the model generates a continuation from a given prefix.
outputs: Generated passage continuations, masked name predictions, and author/title identifications
Generated book title and author (direct probing), filled masked character name (name cloze), or continuation of a passage (prefix probing).
The generated outputs include book titles and authors, filled-in character names, and passage continuations in various languages and modalities.

quote: Metric: To measure the model's ability to replicate a passage's continuation, we report ChrF++
we report ChrF++ scores, which assesses lexical and semantic similarity between the model's output and the ground‑truth continuation. For direct probing and name cloze we report accuracy.
